summary: Totem and direct-heal hybrid healer. Riptide (new level-60 capstone) is a direct heal plus HoT that also buffs your next Chain Heal on that target, tying single-target and raid healing together.

mechanicalChanges.detail: Most lasting totems (incl. healing ones) now last 5 min instead of Classic's 2 min; Mana Spring and Healing Stream specifically were 1 min in Classic. Short-duration totems (Searing, Magma, Stoneclaw, Earthbind, Grounding, Mana Tide) keep their original short timers.

mechanicalChanges.change: Call of the Elements / Ancestors / Spirits
mechanicalChanges.detail: New multi-totem drop spells: each drops up to four totems from its own totem bar set in a single 3 sec cast (Elements at 20, Ancestors at 30, Spirits at 40).

statPriority.notes: Throughput stats (Healing Power, Crit) are generally favored over pure mana-sustain stats at leveling/dungeon pace since encounters are short.

priority: Keep beneficial totems up for the group
Maintain Riptide on the tank / sustained-damage targets
Use Mana Tide Totem when safe to drop (out of combat or in a lull)
Nature's Swiftness + Healing Wave/Chain Heal for instant emergency heals
Chain Heal for AoE/raid healing, prioritizing targets that already have Riptide
Healing Wave / Lesser Healing Wave (downranked when appropriate) for single-target efficiency

keyTalents: Riptide (7/2 capstone) — direct heal + HoT, sets up a stronger Chain Heal
Nature's Swiftness — instant cast on next Nature spell under 10 sec cast time
Water Shield — passive mana return, replaces Classic's reliance on Mana Spring alone
Mana Tide Totem — burst mana restoration for the group
Ancestral Healing — armor buff on your target after a healing crit
caveat: Forever is in beta; numbers and talent effects can change with hotfixes. Cross-check against data/shaman.json before publishing hard numbers.
